scripts.title: Get all difficulty faces
scripts.features: get all difficulty
scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Difficulties = workspace:WaitForChild("Difficulties", 9e9)

local GetEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Get", 9e9)

for _, difficulty in ipairs(Difficulties:GetChildren()) do
    if difficulty:IsA("BasePart") then
        local args = {
            difficulty
        }

        GetEvent:FireServer(unpack(args))
    end
end
